advent_week_rule: week n = 1 + whole weeks from the first Sunday of Advent to today (1 to 4); the fourth week runs to 24 December; a card in the advent colourway outside Advent draws the single candle, advent.svg

placement.rule: Left of the top line, right after 'Warta jemaat . church' (measured end + 24 px), centred on the kicker's line (y 96).
placement.why: The kicker line is the one line every kind of this family draws; a 2% sign beside a caps label is what GKI Bromo does (yt-4Nzs8kJy2YU.jpg).
placement.never: Editorial greige lists no icon rule; the sign is a type ornament in the accent.

placement.rule: A round orange sticker 72 px across at the right end of the pill row (centre x2-36, y 84), the mark 48 px in ink inside it.
placement.why: Pill poster already speaks in round stickers (the KHUSUS stamp and the DAFTAR disc, d2.rs lines 22 and 105); the mark rides one more, in the top corner nothing else uses.
placement.never: No rule against it; the sticker is the family's own shape.

placement.rings: first ring of the kind's deco list with a diameter of 200 or less
placement.rule: Inside the first neon ring of the kind with a diameter of 200 px or less, centred, 50% of the ring's diameter (S01 88, S04 75, S06 60 px), in the ring's own colour.
placement.why: The ring is empty decoration (d3.json deco); a season mark inside it adds nothing to the slide and the ring's colour already passes the 3:1 mark pair on night1.
placement.never: No rule against it; the ring is the family's ornament.

placement.rule: In the top right corner of the navy area, 56 px, at x2-56 and y 40, in sky. Where the kind has no navy at the top right (verse, notice with a picture) it sits after the kicker in blue, 48 px.
placement.why: The navy panel is already a side strip in the season's colour (d4.rs ground()); the mark is a corner sign on that strip, as GKI Bromo puts the pastor circle on its purple strip (yt--5cdDw3leRQ.jpg).

placement.rule: After the church name on the top line (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 88; the church name's maxw is lowered by 72.
placement.why: Plain ground, one line on top; the quietest place a sign can go (sgo-ash-wednesday.jpg: a small cross on a hairline).

placement.rule: After 'Warta jemaat' on the top line (measured end + 24 px), centred on the cap height of the kicker (baseline 84, so y 73); mute, never accent.
placement.why: The default look. The mark is set like a fleuron: same colour as the caps label, 9 px clear of the rule at y 106, accent kept for the highlight.
placement.never: templates-default.md candidate A says 'no icon'. This card amends it by one clause: no icon except the season mark, in mute, beside the kicker. Alternative if the owner refuses: no mark, the wash alone.

placement.fallback_if_overruled: after the footer kicker, mute, 48 px
placement.rule: No mark. The colourway (block, accent) carries the season.
placement.why: Swiss numerals says no icon, no rounded shape, one accent only for the highlight and the total (templates-default.md candidate B). A round-capped sign breaks all three.

placement.rule: No mark. The tinted ground and the pill carry the season.
placement.why: Quiet tint says no icon and no second accent (templates-default.md candidate C); its pill is the only coloured shape.

placement.fallback_if_overruled: after the band kicker, band_mute, 48 px
placement.rule: No mark. The black band and its accent carry the season.
placement.why: Civic board says no icon and no rounded corner (templates-default.md candidate D); a departure-board header takes no pictogram.

placement.rule: After the kicker on the header block (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 62; the header's room() is lowered by 72.
placement.why: The kicker sits on the deep block in sky; the sign takes the same ink, so it is already a tested pair (sky on brand_dk).

placement.rule: Replaces the small cross between the two gold rules: centred at (960, 92), 56 px, gold. The rules keep their ends 40 px from the centre, so the 80 px gap holds it.
placement.why: The family's only pictogram is that cross (d11.json cross_*); a season swaps it for the season's sign and draws it again when no season applies.
placement.never: Nothing amended: the slot already holds a sign.

placement.rule: After the kicker on the photo (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 72, white at the kicker's 90% opacity.
placement.why: Words on the photo sit on a scrim; the sign takes the kicker's own white, so it is as safe as the words.

placement.rule: After the kicker on the signal band (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 56, in deep.
placement.why: Hard blocks, one mark on the band beside the label, in the same near-black the label has.

placement.rule: After the kicker (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 84, in accent.
placement.why: Accent on g2 is already one of the family's listed mark pairs.

placement.rule: After 'Warta jemaat' in the top left folio line (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 56; the church name at the right is left out when it no longer fits, as it already is.
placement.why: A magazine folio line carries a small ornament; accent on ground is a listed mark pair.

placement.rule: At the right end of the top row, right edge at x2, centred on y 50 (the kicker stays at y 38; the chip below starts at y 89); the kicker's maxw is lowered by 72.
placement.why: The kicker row is only 54 px under the top edge, so a sign beside it would leave the title-safe area; the right corner above the chip is empty in every kind.

placement.rule: After the kicker (measured end + 24 px), centred on y 80; the arches at the right stay behind nothing.
placement.why: Warm tone-on-tone with one accent; the arches rise at the right, so the left of the kicker line is free.

items.s: Season marks and four families in two seasons
SEASONMARK1. Sixteen marks, currentColor only, drawn here at 160 px. Wireframes at 1920 x 1080 from spec.json; each red box is the mark's rectangle.
Rendered by resvg-js (bunx @resvg/resvg-js-cli, bundled faces); text widths measured with fontTools, so a kicker's end is within a few percent of the engine's.
Serif italic (d6): the mark follows the kicker word on the top line
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 48 px . role mute
Easter . colourway paskah (existing, light) . mark easter . 48 px . role mute
Neon night (d3): the mark sits inside the first neon ring
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 88 px . the ring's colour
Easter . colourway paskah (existing, dark) . mark easter . 88 px . the ring's colour
Liturgy (d11): the mark takes the place of the small cross
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 56 px . role gold
Easter . colourway paskah (new, light) . mark easter . 56 px . role gold
Warm (d17): the mark follows the kicker on the top line
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 48 px . role accent
Easter . colourway paskah (existing, light) . mark easter . 48 px . role accent
The sixteen marks at 48, 64, 96 and 160 px on a light and a dark ground
Stroke weight test at 48 px: 1.5, 2 (chosen) and 2.5 units, light and dark
Two designs for marking a season, drawn on the same two cards
A: a 48 px sign beside the kicker. B: a 160 px emblem in the top right corner, as the church packs do. Red boxes are the mark's rectangle.
Serif italic, Christmas: A the sign, 48 px
covers nothing: the mark's rectangle meets no other drawn element
Serif italic, Christmas: B the emblem, 160 px
Liturgy, Easter: A the sign, 56 px
covers nothing: the mark's rectangle meets no other drawn element
Liturgy, Easter: B the emblem, 160 px
covers nothing: the mark's rectangle meets no other drawn element
Share of the sheet: A 0.111%, B 1.235%.
B's top right rectangle lands on a drawn element in 15 of 17 families (free only in d2 and d11), its bottom right one inside the body area in 17 of 17; A meets nothing in the four wireframes.
Where B fits (d11's empty corner, drawn here) it is a poster, not a data card; A takes 72 px of one existing line, which the kicker already gives up when it is too long.
Recommended: A. B stays as the size for a gallery tile or a title-only card with no table (the church packs' posters carry no data).
